instructions.en: Grasp the eraser, time the moving gate, and pass through its opening to place the eraser stably in the green tray behind it. Withdraw the whole gripper before the gate closes. Do not touch the gate, frame or rails.
instructions.zh: 抓起板擦，看准移动闸门的开合时机，从开口穿过去，把板擦稳稳放进后面的绿色托盘，并在闸门关闭前把整个夹爪撤出来。不要碰闸门、门框或导轨。

instructions.en: Grasp the eraser, time the moving gates, and pass through the blue then the orange opening to place the eraser stably in the green tray behind them. Withdraw the whole gripper past the outer gate before they close. Do not touch any gate, frame or rail.
instructions.zh: 抓起板擦，看准移动闸门的开合时机，先后穿过蓝色和橙色开口，把板擦稳稳放进后面的绿色托盘，并在两道闸门关闭前把整个夹爪撤到外门以外。不要碰任何闸门、门框或导轨。
